# What’s New in TimeVault 1.0.4
- Approved backup-volume access is restored more reliably when TimeVault launches or becomes active again. - Security-scoped bookmarks are refreshed when stale, deduplicated, and revalidated when backup drives mount or unmount. - Full Disk Access recovery now gives clearer guidance when an update was installed with a different signing identity. - Release packaging now requires a stable certificate-backed signing identity so macOS can recognize signed updates consistently.
